about: Write facts and how far playback got in, the owed line out. In v1 the engine holds this ledger (docs/contracts/voice-wire-v1.md section 5a); the client only reports which line ids played whole and whether the turn was cut off, and the engine maps line ids to the fact ids each line covers. Fact ids here are the wire's fact_id; `played` lists the facts whose line played to the end.
sources: app/src/main/java/com/kevin/legion/service/cascade/OwedWrites.kt and CascadeRules.kt ScriptedLines.doneLine at the same commit

rules.said: ok and changed and not silent: code says a line for it
rules.unconfirmed: no result came back (confirmed false) and not silent; a relayed call the engine timed out is one
rules.owed_when: said and its line did not play to the end; or, on a cut-off turn only, unconfirmed
rules.never_owed: a failed or refused write (ok false with a result), a write with changed false
rules.identity: facts are matched by id: two identical writes are two debts; a fact once heard is never owed again
rules.line: 'Done: ' + clauses joined by '; ' + '.', at most 80 characters, the rest counted as 'and N more'; 'That change went through.' for a write with no phrase; 'I couldn't confirm that <title> went through.' for one unconfirmed write

ops.owe: a turn ended and the client's next report arrived: `turn` lists the turn's facts by id, `played` the facts whose line played to the end, `cut_off` whether playback was stopped
ops.due: what is owed now: expect the line, or null; with no expect the step only takes the due line for a later pay_due
ops.pay_due: the line from the last `due` played to the end: its facts are heard
ops.write_down: the conversation closes with no further turn: what is owed plus every unconfirmed fact not heard (cut off or not) is written to the record once; expect that line, or null
